rca of the issue: Prior bug: Navbar.goTo synchronously called setOpen(false) + scrollIntoView, causing AnimatePresence height-collapse to short-circuit the in-flight smooth scroll on mobile. Fix applied by main agent: scrollIntoView is now deferred by 400ms via setTimeout when the mobile menu was open, allowing the height-collapse exit animation (~0.35s) to complete before scroll begins. Verified working.
